title: Cold Water, Please
can_do: 说出饿或渴，并提出一个能满足需要的请求。
trigger: After coming in from active play, the child notices thirst while Mom asks whether to continue.
stretch_response: I'm thirsty. Can I have some water, please?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: You came in from outside. Do you want to keep playing?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I'm thirsty. Can I have some water, please?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Yes. Cold water or warm water?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Cold water, please. I want the blue cup.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Here is cold water in the blue cup.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Thank you. I feel better after a drink.

replay_cards.title: A small snack
replay_cards.challenge: Say the need, choose between two available snacks, eat, and then get ready

replay_cards.title: Water in the car
replay_cards.change: The child notices thirst before buckling in
replay_cards.challenge: Ask for the water bottle, take a drink while parked, then buckle in

parent_support: Respond first to the body need, then offer one or two realistic options.
Do not require a polished sentence before meeting an urgent need.
